label: SW8 stormheart calm
brief: Inside the hollow base of the giant Stormheart tree, four fixed exploration views (2x2 grid) in the calm storm phase, timber decks ringing the trunk walls, with the 1.80 m trainer as a ruler. Judge whether it reads as the inside of a colossal living storm tree from the key art.
defects: the lightning core reads as a free-standing rigid white light tube, not part of the tree
white sky strip through the trunk
eye-height fog puffs or flat white decals on the ground

defects: the lightning core reads as a free-standing rigid white light tube, not part of the tree
